fixture: Stand-in for the Source and Evidence records (PLATFORM P2c) until they exist. Each statement says whether it is a paraphrase or a quotation; a quotation holds its verbatim excerpt word for word. Excerpts are copied from research/science/source-register.md: kind verbatim is the paper's wording as the register quotes it; kind register_note is the register's own summary of the paper, not the paper's wording; kind stored_text is a phrase SCIENCE-GEO checked against the privately stored text (S6), recorded with its page in research/geospatial/study-area.md.
